identity.title: Far-infrared laboratory spectroscopy of aminoacetonitrile and first interstellar detection of its vibrationally excited transitions

paper_type_evidence.quote: We used the imaging spectral line survey ReMoCA performed with ALMA to search for vibrationally excited aminoacetonitrile toward Sgr B2(N1).

evidence.quote: Sgr B2(N1S) is located at ($\alpha, \delta$)$_{\rm J2000}$= ($17^{\rm h}47^{\rm m}19{s}870$, $-28^\circ22\ensuremath{^{\prime}} 19{\ensuremath{''}}48$), about 1$\ensuremath{^{\prime\!\prime}}$ to the south of Sgr B2(N1).
at a distance of 8.2 kpc from the Sun (cite: Reid19)

question.value: Can accurate vibrational energies and partition function of aminoacetonitrile from FIR laboratory spectroscopy enable detection of its vibrationally excited states toward Sgr B2(N1) in ReMoCA data?

evidence.quote: We wanted to accurately determine the energies of the low-lying vibrational states of aminoacetonitrile, which are expected to be populated in Sgr B2(N1), the main hot core of Sgr B2(N).
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00074.S.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 84.1-114.4 GHz, five tunings, 488 kHz resolution (1.7 to 1.3 km/s)

evidence.quote: the observations covered the frequency range from 84.1 GHz to 114.4 GHz with five tunings, with a spectral resolution of 488 kHz (1.7 to 1.3 km s$^{-1}$).

lines_targeted.transition: rotational lines in v=0, v11=1, v18=1 (also searched v17=1, v11=2)

evidence.quote: we could identify four and one rotational transitions from within the vibrationally excited states $\varv_{11}=1$ and $\varv_{18}=1$, respectively.
The angular resolution (HPBW) varied between $\sim$0.3$\ensuremath{^{\prime\!\prime}}$ and $\sim$0.8$\ensuremath{^{\prime\!\prime}}$, with a median value of 0.6$\ensuremath{^{\prime\!\prime}}$
The rms sensitivity ranged from 0.35 mJy beam$^{-1}$ to 1.1 mJy beam$^{-1}$, with a median value of 0.8 mJy beam$^{-1}$.

provided.value: Synchrotron FIR absorption spectra of aminoacetonitrile, 100-500 cm-1

evidence.quote: The FIR spectrum of aminoacetonitrile was recorded between 100 and 500  cm$^{-1}$ on the AILES[^2] beamline of the SOLEIL synchrotron facility.

what.value: Pure rotational transition frequencies of ground and excited states included in the fit

evidence.quote: Pure rotational transitions of the ground state (cite: macdonald1972microwave; pickett1973microwave; brown1977quadrupole; bogey1990millemeter; motoki2013submillimeter) and excited states of aminoacetonitrile (cite: degli2017millimeter) were also included in the analysis.

analysis_steps.goal: Laboratory spectral fit and partition function

method.value: Weighted least-squares fit of ~11000 ro-vibrational and >2000 rotational lines with Watson S-reduced Hamiltonian plus Coriolis term; partition function from SPCAT

evidence.quote: The newly observed ro-vibrational transitions were analyzed in a weighted least-squares procedure performed with the `SPFIT` subprogram of the `CALPGM` suite (cite: pickett1991).

key_parameters.value: Uncertainties 1e-4 cm-1 for new data; 1.5e-4 cm-1 for v11 band

evidence.quote: A conservative uncertainty of $1.5\times10^{-4}$  cm$^{-1}$ was given to the transition frequencies of the weaker $\nu_{11}$ band

assumptions.value: Dipole moments unchanged upon vibrational excitation

evidence.quote: assumed to not change upon the vibrational states.
The overall standard deviation of the fit ($\sigma$) is 0.99

analysis_steps.goal: LTE modelling of ReMoCA spectrum at Sgr B2(N1S)

method.value: Weeds LTE synthetic spectrum with 5 parameters per species, combining all identified molecules; v=0 fit first, same parameters applied to vibrational states

evidence.quote: We derived a best-fit synthetic spectrum of each molecule separately, and then added the contributions of all identified molecules together.

key_parameters.value: size 2", T=200 K, N=1.1e17 cm-2, dV=5.0 km/s, Voff=0, Vsys=62 km/s

evidence.quote: under the assumption of local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE), which is appropriate given the high densities

validation.value: Gaussian size fit of six least-contaminated lines gave ~1.9"

evidence.quote: yields a mean size of $\sim$1.9$\ensuremath{^{\prime\!\prime}}$ with an rms dispersion of $\sim$0.15$\ensuremath{^{\prime\!\prime}}$

method.value: Population diagram after correction for optical depth and contamination

evidence.quote: The fit to the population diagram of Fig. 5b yields a rotational temperature of $245 \pm 47$ K.
have been input in the `SPCAT` subroutine (cite: pickett1991) to compute the ro-vibrational partition function of aminoacetonitrile analytically.
The assignment procedure was performed with the Loomis-Wood for Windows (LWW) program package

results_numeric.quantity: Column density of aminoacetonitrile at Sgr B2(N1S)

evidence.quote: The column density of aminoacetonitrile derived from our LTE modelling of the ReMoCA spectrum toward Sgr B2(N1S), $1.1 \times 10^{17}$ cm$^{-2}$
yields a rotational temperature of $245 \pm 47$ K
an observational ratio of $5.5 \times 10^{-3}$ is found

findings_qualitative.value: Four v11=1 lines and one v18=1 line detected, consistent with LTE; v17=1 and v11=2 contribute but are not securely identified

evidence.quote: No transitions of $\varv_{17}=1$ and $\varv_{11}=2$ are unambiguously detected, but some of them contribute significantly to the signal detected with ALMA

claims.hypothesis: Vibrationally excited aminoacetonitrile is detectable toward Sgr B2(N1S) with new spectroscopy
claims.experiment: LTE modelling of ReMoCA spectrum with new catalogs
claims.result: 4 v11=1 and 1 v18=1 lines consistent with model at 200 K, N=1.1e17

evidence.quote: we report the interstellar detection of aminoacetonitrile in its $\varv_{11}=1$ and $\varv_{18}=1$ vibrational states toward Sgr B2(N1)

claims.hypothesis: Precise vibrational energies can be determined from FIR spectrum
claims.experiment: Synchrotron FT-FIR spectrum and combined fit
claims.result: Energies with relative uncertainty down to 2e-8

evidence.quote: the determination of the vibrational energies of all the three excited states of aminoacetonitrile with relative uncertainties as low as $2 \times 10^{-8}$

limitations_admitted.value: Rotational temperature uncertain due to continuum and contamination; spectral baseline quality limited

evidence.quote: These are the reasons why the fitted rotational temperature is uncertain, and its (purely) statistical uncertainty may be underestimated.

referee_caveats_inferred: Only five vibrationally excited lines detected; the detection rests on LTE model without formal significance
Temperature fixed at 200 K versus 245 K from population diagram

evidence.quote: The interferometric data are available in the ALMA archive at https://almascience.eso.org/aq/.
